title: Nat call deck, Tue 20 Oct
source: JEM refresh Tue 20 Oct 2026: only venues that never replied by email or went quiet 14+ days (no live email threads). Once-interested quiet first (clubs, warmest, most recent interest), then never-replied clubs (longest silence). Real phone required. Built by /workspace/deck-refresh/build_calls.py

freeNights.nights: Sun 15, 22 Nov (Sat 7 Nov is held for Sutton Social, do not offer)
Sun 27 Dec (Sun 20 Dec now taken; NYE is booked)
Saturdays: 2 Jan · 27 Mar · 10 Apr · 11 Sep · 16 Oct · 6, 20 Nov (6 Mar, 5 Jun and 11 Dec are pencilled for Sutton Social; May, Jul and Aug fully booked)

rules: Check both calendars before offering any date.
New price: £300 cash for one night of 2 x 1 hour, or £250 a night if they book four dates. Never £250 for a single night and never below £250.
A quote already given stands as quoted. Never restate a fee already agreed.
Cash or books fee only. Never ticket or door deals.
Never offer Sat 17 Oct. NYE is booked.
